body:
Refs #24 (FA-023). Closure is a separate step; the GitHub issue stays OPEN.

## Problem
The upstream validators reported structural "ok" when no check ran, accepted unknown keywords silently, passed NaN bounds, let a lexical CLEAN coexist with read errors, called two unrelated files a consensus and folded schema-owner errors into agent failures. Zeus validates with `jsonschema` (bool/int enums, closed objects and `required` already behave — measured in this PR), but a misspelled keyword was a check that silently never ran, results did not say what was checked, configuration errors were not distinguished from agent defects, and tool use existed only as self-report.

## Change (bounded)
- `adapters/output_schema.py`: an explicit `SUPPORTED_KEYWORDS` subset of Draft 2020-12 (subset v1) — any other keyword is refused at preflight with its path (`codex-output-schema-unsupported-keyword`); `enum` requires an explicit `type` like `const`; a closed object cannot `required` names it does not declare; depth (32) and encoded size (256 KiB) are bounded; non-finite numbers are refused; annotations (`examples`, `description`, …) are not walked as schemas. `preflight()` now returns a receipt (`schema_hash`, `dialect`, `subset_version`, `keywords`, `checks`, `max_depth`, `bytes`). Existing messages, paths and hash binding are unchanged.
- `adapters/execution_output.completed_output()`: every result carries `structural.checks` (`text`/`json`/`finite`/`schema` as checked / failed / unchecked / configuration_error) and the preflight receipt; a schema the subset refuses is `failure.owner = 'configuration'` (`codex-output-schema-configuration`) and a valid-looking answer under it is not accepted; agent defects are `owner = 'agent_output'` (existing causes and `output_reason` kept).
- `adapters/execution_output.tool_usage()`: runner-observed command/file-change/MCP items from transport `item/completed` events recorded beside any self-reported `tool_calls`, with `comparison` (`not_declared` / `consistent` / `differs`); the executor puts it in every execution evidence record.
- `docs/contracts.md`: INV-OUTPUT-001 (also states that Zeus keeps no lexical, filename or boilerplate grade). Record: `docs/zeus/implementation/output-validation-001/` (README + receipt with negative controls and the jsonschema probe).

## Verification
- `tests/test_output_validation.py` (5 tests): all eight schemas Zeus sends are inside the subset and get receipts; `requried` (top level) and `minLenght` (nested path) refused, enum without type refused, undeclared required refused, depth 33 refused, NaN minimum refused, `examples` not walked; check states for ok / mismatch / broken JSON / misconfigured schema (owner `configuration`, answer None, JSON still checked) / empty / NaN; observed tool use counts completed items only, ignores started items and non-events, and reports `not_declared` / `consistent` / `differs`; executor evidence carries one observed `commandExecution` from a real protocol replay.
- Existing output/app-server/executor suites: 126 passed with the change. Negative controls: unknown keywords accepted → 2 fail; enum without type accepted → 1 fails; configuration errors owned by the agent → 1 fails; started items counted as observed → 1 fails.
- Windows full suite on origin/main `1488468`: 955 passed, 310 skipped. `ruff check` clean.

## Not claimed
The subset is the explicit list of keywords Zeus sends, not a full JSON Schema implementation (new keywords require a list change and a subset version bump). No lexical/consensus/boilerplate signals exist or were added; structural validity and observed tool use are review evidence, never SDD acceptance or Astra/Sol/Terra qualification; no Windows/Linux/WSL path/encoding runs.

comments.body:
검토 반영 — `5fbb7a4` (P1: 선언 dialect와 검증 dialect 불일치)

**변경**
- `adapters/output_schema.py`: `$schema`가 있으면 2020-12 URI만 허용(그 외는 configuration error로 거절). preflight 영수증에 `validator=jsonschema.Draft202012Validator`, `format="annotation only: never asserted"` 명시.
- `adapters/execution_output.py`: `Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=None).validate(...)`로 영수증과 같은 dialect로 검증. `tool_usage`는 `params=None`/누락을 방어.

**테스트**: draft-07 선언 + prefixItems → configuration error(owner configuration); 2020-12 선언 → `["not-an-integer"]` 거절, `[3]` 수용; `format: date-time` 위반 값은 통과하고 영수증이 annotation-only를 말함; `params=None` 이벤트는 tool item도 crash도 아님.

main(`66076cc`) 위로 rebase. 로컬: 6 passed; Ruff 통과.

reviews.body:
# PR #55: 변경 요청 / 병합 보류

검토 head: `fc35ed0dcd9d3a9af31ddb712761b614d88055c6`. Codex 독립 검토입니다.

**[P1] 선언한 JSON Schema dialect와 실제 검증 dialect가 다릅니다**

schema에 $schema=draft-07, type=array, prefixItems=[{type:integer}]를 주고 ["not-an-integer"]를 검사하면 answer가 수용되고 schema=checked입니다. preflight 영수증은 2020-12를 주장하지만 jsonschema.validate가 draft-07을 선택해 prefixItems를 무시합니다.

위치: [src/codex_harness/adapters/execution_output.py:64](https://github.com/trevi00/zeus/blob/fc35ed0dcd9d3a9af31ddb712761b614d88055c6/src/codex_harness/adapters/execution_output.py#L64)

수정·재검증 조건: 지원 dialect를 2020-12로 고정하거나 다른 선언을 거절하고 실제 validator와 영수증을 일치시키세요. 지원 목록의 format도 assertion인지 annotation인지 명시해야 합니다. tool_usage의 params=None 방어도 추가 검토 대상입니다.

검증: 해당 head의 대상 검사 **43 passed in 16.98s**, Ruff 통과. 개별 대상 검사에 PostgreSQL 통합을 활성화했습니다. 통과 횟수는 파일 간 중복을 포함하므로 고유 테스트 수로 합산하지 않습니다.

실제 모델·사람 인수·실기기·재부팅 검증은 수행하지 않았습니다. PR 수용과 연결 이슈의 완료/종료는 별도입니다.
